stages.name: base
stages.text:
Build an annuity mortgage schedule calculator. All money is integer øre; never use floating point for money.
Input (stdin, one JSON object): {"principal": int >= 1, "annual_rate_bp": int >= 0 (basis points per year, 1 bp = 0.01%), "months": int >= 1}.
Monthly rate r = annual_rate_bp / 120000 (exact rational). Fixed payment = principal * r / (1 - (1 + r)^-months), computed exactly and rounded half-up to whole øre; when the rate is 0 the payment is principal / months rounded half-up.
Each month: interest = balance * annual_rate_bp / 120000 rounded half-up to whole øre; principal_paid = payment - interest; balance decreases by principal_paid. In the last month (or as soon as payment - interest >= balance) the month instead pays principal_paid = balance, so the balance ends at exactly 0 and the schedule stops.
Output (stdout, one JSON object): {"payment": int, "schedule": [{"month": int starting at 1, "interest": int, "principal": int, "balance": int (after the month)}], "total_interest": int (sum of interest)}.

stages.name: cr1
stages.text: Change request 1: the input may carry an optional field "extra": [{"month": int, "amount": int >= 1}]. After the regular payment of that month, the extra amount is paid off the balance too and added to that month's "principal". An extra payment never takes the balance below 0 (it is capped at the remaining balance). The regular payment amount stays unchanged, so the loan can end early; the schedule stops at the month the balance reaches 0.

stages.name: cr2
stages.text: Change request 2: the input may carry an optional field "interest_only_months": int k with 0 <= k < months. In the first k months the borrower pays interest only (principal 0, balance unchanged). The fixed payment is computed as an annuity over the remaining months - k, on the full principal, and applies from month k+1. Output "payment" is that annuity payment. Extra payments (CR1) still apply in any month, including interest-only months.

reqs.text: exact annuity payment, half-up rounding to øre; zero rate = principal/months half-up
final month pays off the exact remaining balance; schedule stops at 0
total_interest is the sum of monthly interest
extra payment after regular payment, capped, added to month principal, early end
interest-only months, then annuity over months-k on full principal

mutants.m1: interest truncated instead of rounded half-up
mutants.m2: extra payment not capped at remaining balance
mutants.m3: annuity after interest-only months still computed over all months
